newsitem.title: JAPAN: TENNIS-BECKER SUFFERS UPSET DEFEAT IN DOUBLES.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER SUFFERS UPSET DEFEAT IN DOUBLES.

text.p: Boris Becker was jolted by an upset doubles defeat on Monday on the eve of his opening singles match in the Japan Open.
Becker and fellow German Patrik Kuhnen were beaten 1-6 7-6 6-4 by Japan's Hiroki Ishii and Michihisa Onoda to the disbelief of a crowd of 5,000.
Becker had difficulty maintaining momentum despite serving several aces, while the Japanese pair played steadily and let their opponents make mistakes.
Second seed Becker faces France's Sebastien Lareau in his second round singles match on the clay of the Ariake Tennis Forest Park on Tuesday. He had a bye in the first round.

The tournament is without world number one and triple Japan Open champion Pete Sampras, who has a sprained right wrist, and Swede Thomas Enqvist, who is ill. Dutch Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek is the top seed.
